independentLayers.description: ARIA attributes and activation policy for any element acting as a button; no rendering.
Sorts children into leading / contents / trailing parts and hides empty ones.
Reference numbers for the control family; CSS in styles/geometry.ts implements them.

intent: Turn one option or mode on and off with a button that shows its pressed state, such as bold in a text toolbar

properties.description: The live pressed state (aria-pressed, data-pressed); reflects to the attribute.
Pressed at connect when no pressed attribute is set (Base UI defaultPressed); later changes do nothing.
Blocks activation and leaves the tab order (tabindex −1); data-disabled.
Identifies the toggle for an application-owned group; not submitted (a toggle has no form value).

attributes.name: icon-size
attributes.description: Glyph artwork tier inside the fixed 6u slots: sm = font − 0.5u, md (default) = font + 0.5u, lg = font + 1.5u, fill covers the slot (images use object-fit cover). Carets, the select chevron and the x close icon stay sm. data-icon-size is the same input for plain HTML.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: change
events.trigger: click, Enter or Space while enabled
events.detail: { pressed: boolean, reason: 'none', event: Event } (Base UI Toggle onPressedChange); cancelable: preventDefault keeps the current state

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Runs validation; fires invalid when it fails.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Marks the field touched (errors show) and reports.

methods.name: setCustomValidity
methods.description: Sets an author error; an empty string clears it.

content.children: Label text, icons and adornments; children move into the construction-pattern parts: slot="leading" | "trailing" for icons, slot="prefix" | "suffix" for text adornments, the rest is the label.

constraints: The host is the button: role=button, tabindex 0 (−1 while disabled), aria-pressed and aria-disabled set by script, with the styling state data-pressed and data-disabled (Base UI Toggle; contracts/states.json). Contains no native form elements.
Activation is click, Enter or Space; it fires a cancelable change with the next pressed value, and preventDefault keeps the current one. disabled stops the click.
A toggle has no form value; value only identifies it for an application-owned toggle group.
Its label must not change with the state: aria-pressed says whether it is on.

avoidWhen.when: A setting that takes effect immediately and reads as on / off.
avoidWhen.reason: A switch owns role=switch, aria-checked and a form value.

avoidWhen.when: Choosing one of a few mutually exclusive options.
avoidWhen.reason: Independent toggles cannot own exclusive selection or arrow-key movement; segmented is a single-select listbox.

avoidWhen.when: Filtering by tags or tokens in a set.
avoidWhen.reason: A selectable chip is the compact pressed label, with an optional remove gesture.

avoidWhen.when: An action that does not stay on.
avoidWhen.reason: A button has no pressed state.

props: render?: RenderProp // Replace the part's element (Base UI render): an element (the part's props merge into it) or `(props, state) => element`. The recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.
className?: string | ((state: PartState) => string | undefined) // Author class, or a function of the part's state (Base UI className); added after the recipe class.
pressed?: boolean // Controlled pressed state (Base UI pressed).
defaultPressed?: boolean = false // Uncontrolled initial pressed state (Base UI defaultPressed).
onPressedChange?: (pressed: boolean, details: ChangeDetails) => void // Every user toggle (Base UI onPressedChange): reason 'none'.
value?: string // Identifies the toggle inside a toggle group (Base UI value).
size?: number // Unit u in px (2..12); control height is 8u.
